values.note: Two campgrounds: Savanna (upper, 57 drive-in, 50-amp electric) and Riverway (lower, 53 drive-in, 30-amp electric). 71 electric sites. Three Riverway electric sites (27E, 29E, 31E) take only 20 ft; every other drive-in site takes 23 ft or more.

values.note: Showers, flush toilets, campground water and the dump station run late April to mid-October (off from October 19, 2026); vault toilets all year, and RV tanks can be filled behind the ranger station off-season.

facilities.source: DNR sanitation + seasonal update ('Shower buildings are available from late April through mid-October'; 'The dump station is available late April through mid-October for campers only'; 'Vault toilets are available year-round throughout the park'; alert: seasonal closures begin October 19), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Savanna Campground is open all year; Riverway Campground is open mid-April to October. Water and showers are off from mid-October to late April.

season.source: DNR seasonal update ('The Savanna Campground is open year-round. The Riverway Campground is open mid-April - October.'), read 2026-11-11

note: State park on the St. Croix River near Marine on St. Croix. Two campgrounds: Savanna, on the upland, and Riverway, in woods above the river. Lake Alice's beach, fishing pier and canoe launch are closed for reconstruction until about fall 2027, and the St. Croix boat access is closed to motorboats for low water (both as of November 2026). --Claude
